theme: SLIT-ROBO, netrin and ephrin axon guidance signalling
core_role: The shared pathways are the guidance-cue receptor systems (SLIT/ROBO, netrin/DCC, ephrin/EPH) and their Rho-family GTPase effectors that steer growth cones by attraction and repulsion, framed as the receptor-to-cytoskeleton machinery of axon guidance whose cue expression and extension inhibition the additional pathways regulate.

theme: Glycogen and hexose fuel metabolism and its inherited disorders
core_role: The shared pathways cover glycogen synthesis and breakdown, glucose phosphorylation, fructose and glycerol entry and gluconeogenesis together with the glycogen storage and sugar-metabolism diseases, framed as the storage and release of carbohydrate fuel for glucose homeostasis, which the additional pathways extend to glycolytic flux control, lactate/pyruvate output and energy buffering.

theme: Immediate-early stress response to external stimuli
core_role: The shared pathways (NR4A immediate-early genes, TNF/NF-kB, PI3K/AKT/mTOR and p38 signalling, growth arrest) are framed as the generic immediate-early transcriptional response of cells to environmental stimuli, which the additional pathways specify as UV, phorbol ester and nitric oxide stress.

theme: Sulfation and glycosaminoglycan processing in cartilage
core_role: The shared pathways are PAPS synthesis and transport, sulfate uptake, sulfatase activation (formylglycine generation) and hyaluronan degradation with their chondrodysplasias, framed as sulfate-donor supply and glycosaminoglycan turnover for cartilage proteoglycans, alongside the nucleotide-sugar substrate supply added by the additional pathways.

theme: Urea cycle and arginine-ornithine metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are the urea cycle enzymes, arginine/citrulline/ornithine interconversion and their inherited deficiencies (OTC, NAGS, HHH), framed as hepatic ammonia detoxification, supported by the ornithine and cationic amino acid transport in the additional pathways.

theme: Epithelial sodium handling and osmotic stress responses
core_role: The shared pathways are osmosensing, aldosterone-responsive renal sodium transport, sodium import control and transepithelial chloride transport, framed as regulated epithelial salt transport for osmotic and volume homeostasis, with the additional pathways adding the linked control of potassium and sodium transporter activity.

theme: Amino acid neurotransmitter synthesis, uptake and recycling
core_role: The shared pathways are GABA synthesis, release, reuptake (including taurine-carrying GABA transporters) and degradation, framed as the inhibitory GABAergic neurotransmitter cycle that sits beside the glutamate/aspartate uptake and astrocytic glutamate-glutamine cycling in the additional pathways.

theme: Reactive carbonyl and oxidative stress defence
core_role: The shared pathways are methylglyoxal and aldehyde detoxification and repair of damaged proteins, framed as defence against reactive carbonyl damage within the broader redox and ROS-detoxification response represented by the additional pathways.

theme: Phosphate homeostasis via FGF23-Klotho, PTH and mineralization
core_role: The shared pathways are FGF23/Klotho and PTH signalling controlling renal sodium-phosphate transport and bone mineralization, framed as endocrine regulation of systemic phosphate balance, with the additional pathways adding phosphate transporters and ectopic calcification disorders.

theme: Membrane lipid transfer and bilayer organization
core_role: The shared pathways are non-vesicular transfer of glycolipids, ceramide-1-phosphate and PI/PC between membranes by lipid transfer proteins, framed as inter-organelle lipid supply that sets membrane composition, complemented by flippase-driven transbilayer translocation and vesicular traffic in the additional pathways.

theme: Osteoclast formation and bone resorption
core_role: The shared pathways are macrophage-to-osteoclast fusion, osteoclast differentiation and proliferation and control of bone resorption, framed as osteoclastogenesis in bone remodelling, with the additional pathways supplying DAP12 signalling and the membrane-fusion step of syncytium formation.

theme: Repulsive axon guidance at the midline and beyond
core_role: The shared pathways are SLIT/ROBO and netrin signalling governing commissural midline crossing, chemorepulsion and axon extension via RAC1/CDC42/RHOA, framed as the midline-guidance branch of a wider axon guidance cue system that the additional pathways complete with semaphorin-plexin, ephrin and DCC attraction.

theme: Amino acid neurotransmitter transport and recycling
core_role: The shared pathways are plasma-membrane reuptake of glutamate, aspartate and GABA by SLC transporters, glial glutamate-glutamine cycling and their transporter disorders, framed as synaptic clearance and recycling of amino acid neurotransmitters, ahead of the vesicular loading in the additional pathways.

theme: Neurotrophin receptor signalling for neuronal death and survival
core_role: The shared pathways are p75NTR signalling (proNGF binding, regulated proteolysis, NRAGE/NRIF/JNK death signals, ceramide, NF-kB survival) and dependence-receptor caspase activation, framed as the apoptosis-versus-survival arm of neurotrophin signalling, set against the TrkA trophic signalling in the additional pathways.

theme: Gluconeogenesis, glycolysis and fructose metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are gluconeogenesis, fructose catabolism and alanine metabolism with fructose disorders, framed as hepatic routing of fructose and alanine carbon into glucose production, which the additional pathways oppose and complete with glycolysis and glucose uptake/phosphorylation.

theme: Phagocytic clearance of apoptotic cells and debris
core_role: The shared pathways are efferocytosis (phosphatidylserine exposure, recognition, engulfment), microglial activation and amyloid-beta clearance, framed as phagocytic removal of dying cells and debris, extended by scavenger receptor uptake of modified lipoproteins and immune complexes in the additional pathways.

theme: Integrated stress response and unfolded protein response
core_role: The shared pathways are eIF2alpha-kinase (PERK, GCN2, HRI) control of translation initiation, IRE1 signalling and ER-stress-induced apoptosis, framed as translational and cell-fate control under proteostatic and nutrient stress, with ATF4/XBP1 transcriptional outputs and the mitochondrial UPR added by the additional pathways.

theme: Early kidney development from nephric duct to metanephros
core_role: The shared pathways are pronephros, mesonephros and nephric duct formation and regulation of metanephric development and kidney size, framed as the sequential nephric stages of kidney organogenesis, with intermediate mesoderm and ureteric bud morphogenesis supplied by the additional pathways.

theme: DNA double-strand break repair and response
core_role: The shared pathways are DSB sensing and ATM signalling, NHEJ and alt-EJ, regulation of HR, PARylation, Fanconi crosslink repair, fork reversal and BRCA1/BRCA2 defects, framed as the damage response and repair-pathway choice at double-strand breaks, while the additional pathways supply the HR execution steps of resection, RAD51 loading, SSA and D-loop resolution.

theme: Threonine and glycine amino acid catabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are threonine catabolism to glycine, glyoxylate metabolism and generic amino/organic acid metabolism terms, framed as catabolic interconversion of small amino acids and their keto/aldehyde acids, linked to alanine-glyoxylate transamination by the additional pathways.

theme: Cytosolic RNA sensing to type I interferon
core_role: The shared pathways are RIG-I/MDA5 sensing of dsRNA and TBK1/IKKepsilon-mediated IRF3 activation with their negative regulators, framed as antiviral innate immune signalling to type I interferon, broadened by TLR-driven IRF7 and IFN-alpha/beta production in the additional pathways.

theme: Inflammasome activation and IL-1 family cytokine processing
core_role: The shared pathways are NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome assembly (including P2X7 purinergic triggering) and caspase-1 processing of IL-1 precursors, framed as innate inflammatory cytokine maturation, extended to IL-18 production and signalling in the additional pathways.

theme: Axon guidance in neuronal subtype wiring
core_role: The shared pathways are attractive and repulsive regulation of axon extension and anterior/posterior guidance applied to dopaminergic, serotonergic and DRG neurons, framed as developmental wiring of specific neuronal populations, extended to peripheral and sympathetic innervation by the additional pathways.

theme: Negative feedback control of ERK MAPK signalling
core_role: The shared pathways are phosphatase-mediated dephosphorylation and inactivation of ERKs, RSK activation, Ras suppression and MAPK mutant signalling, framed as feedback termination of the ERK cascade whose activation steps appear in the additional pathways.

theme: Fructose, glycerol and gluconeogenic sugar-phosphate metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are fructose metabolism, glycerol/alditol metabolism and gluconeogenesis interconverting triose and hexose phosphates, framed as hepatic entry of non-glucose carbons into glucose production, set against glycolysis and its fructose-2,6-bisphosphate control in the additional pathways.

theme: Stress, arousal and motivated behaviour
core_role: The shared pathways are CRH and corticosterone stress responses, orexin-driven wakefulness, fear and motivated behaviours such as drinking, parental care and ethanol response, framed as neuropeptide and stress-hormone control of arousal and behaviour, extended to mating and aggression in the additional pathways.

theme: Amino sugar, sialic acid and glycosylation metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are N-acetylglucosamine, mannose and sialic acid metabolism, lysosomal oligosaccharide catabolism and the GNE/MAN1B1 disorders, framed as supply and recycling of glycan building blocks that feed the UDP-GlcNAc synthesis and N-glycosylation steps and CDGs in the additional pathways.

theme: Circadian clock machinery and metabolic outputs
core_role: The shared pathways are the BMAL1/CLOCK-CRY/PER transcriptional feedback loop, ROR/REV-ERB control, clock protein phosphorylation and degradation and light entrainment, framed as the core molecular clock that drives the PGC-1alpha, PPARalpha and heme metabolic outputs in the additional pathways.

theme: Innate social, motivated and reward behaviours
core_role: The shared pathways are behavioural phenotypes (mating, parental, aggressive, exploratory, grooming, drinking, ethanol response) and amygdala development, framed as emotional and motivated behaviour circuits, which the additional pathways extend to reward learning and drug responses.

theme: Neutral amino acid transport and its disorders
core_role: The shared pathways are SLC6A19 (Hartnup) and proton-coupled transport of neutral amino acids such as tryptophan, proline and glycine, framed as epithelial absorption and reabsorption of amino acids, with other SLC transporter disease variants added by the additional pathways.

theme: Selective autophagy and autophagosome regulation
core_role: The shared pathways are selective autophagy of ER, mitochondria, peroxisomes and nucleus and the regulation of autophagosome assembly and maturation (including ATG8 delipidation and depalmitoylation), framed as cargo-selective autophagic degradation, with UFMylation and nutrient or oxygen deprivation triggers added by the additional pathways.

theme: Meiotic chromosome cohesion and segregation
core_role: The shared pathways are meiotic sister chromatid cohesion, chiasma assembly, spindle alignment, checkpoint signalling and metaphase-anaphase control, framed as accurate chromosome segregation in (female) meiosis, preceded by the DSB formation and synapsis steps in the additional pathways.

theme: Sulfur and selenium amino acid catabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are transsulfuration, cysteine and sulfur amino acid catabolism, taurine (alkanesulfonate) metabolism and the conversion of selenoamino acids to methylated selenide for excretion, framed as catabolism of sulfur and selenium amino acids, continued by sulfide oxidation in the additional pathways.

theme: Actin dynamics driving cell motility
core_role: The shared pathways are actin nucleation, capping, severing, crosslinking, polymerization and depolymerization and ruffle formation, framed as the actin filament turnover that powers protrusion, which the additional pathways deploy in lamellipodia, pseudopodia and leading-edge migration.

theme: Base excision repair of damaged DNA bases
core_role: The shared pathways are DNA glycosylase recognition and excision of damaged purines and pyrimidines, NEIL1/NEIL3 function including crosslink resolution, and AP site handling, framed as the damage-recognition and initiating steps of base excision repair, completed by the gap-filling and long-patch steps in the additional pathways.

theme: Cobalamin and B-vitamin cofactor transport and metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are cellular cobalamin transport and processing, the B12-dependent enzymes MUT and MTR, propionyl-CoA catabolism, biotin metabolism and their inborn errors, framed as B12/biotin cofactor-dependent metabolism, extended by intestinal B12 uptake and thiamine, riboflavin and folate transport in the additional pathways.

theme: Peroxisomal fatty acid beta-oxidation
core_role: The shared pathways are acyl-CoA oxidase-dependent beta-oxidation of very-long-chain and branched (pristanoyl) fatty acids, medium/long-chain acyl-CoA handling and TYSND1 peroxisomal processing, framed as peroxisomal lipid catabolism, with VLCFA import (ABCD1/ALD) and peroxisome fission in the additional pathways.

theme: Renal electrolyte reabsorption by cation-chloride cotransporters
core_role: The shared pathways are SLC12 cotransporters (NKCC2, NCC, KCC3), potassium channels, paracellular and magnesium handling and the Bartter/Gitelman disorders, framed as tubular salt and electrolyte reabsorption, with tight-junction paracellular magnesium transport added by the additional pathways.

theme: Cation-chloride cotransport in cell volume and renal salt regulation
core_role: The shared pathways are SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters, osmosensory signalling and hypo/hyperosmotic responses with renal sodium/chloride transport, framed as cell volume regulation and renal salt reabsorption, with sodium and potassium transporter control added by the additional pathways.

theme: IL-10 and IL-12 family immunoregulatory cytokine signalling
core_role: The shared pathways are IL-10, IL-12, IL-23, IL-27, IL-35 and IL-20 family signalling and regulation of IL-10 production, framed as cytokine control balancing pro-inflammatory and anti-inflammatory immune responses, with IL-37 and other interleukins in the additional pathways.

theme: Adherens junctions and cadherin-mediated cell adhesion
core_role: The shared pathways are calcium-dependent cadherin adhesion and adherens junction assembly, framed as formation of epithelial cell-cell junctions, which the additional pathways extend to junction maintenance and epithelial adhesion.

theme: Specialized pro-resolving lipid mediator biosynthesis
core_role: The shared pathways are biosynthesis of resolvins, protectins, maresins and lipoxins from omega-3 fatty acids and arachidonate, framed as lipid-mediated resolution of inflammation, with eicosanoid and leukotriene inactivation by omega-oxidation in the additional pathways.

theme: Centrosome positioning and microtubule organization in cell division
core_role: The shared pathways are centrosome cohesion and positioning, MTOC-based microtubule nucleation and stability and cortical protein localization (including citron kinase), framed as cytoskeletal organization for spindle and polarity during division, coupled to the cytokinetic contractile ring and Rho cycle in the additional pathways.

theme: Cardiac calcium cycling and contraction-relaxation control
core_role: The shared pathways are SERCA regulation, sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium uptake and release, cardiac membrane potential and relaxation, framed as cardiomyocyte calcium handling for excitation-contraction coupling, linked to heart rate and contractility in the additional pathways.

theme: PAX3 and cadherin transcriptional control in EMT
core_role: The shared pathways are PAX3 targets and transcriptional regulation of the cadherins CDH1, CDH11 and CDH19, framed as transcriptional switching of adhesion programmes in neural crest and epithelial-mesenchymal transition, under the TGF-beta/BMP signalling and transcriptional repression in the additional pathways.

theme: NOTCH signalling and target gene transcription
core_role: The shared pathways are NOTCH2/3/4 intracellular-domain transcription, HLH target regulation and Notch control of Th2 and pancreatic differentiation, framed as Notch-driven cell-fate transcription, with NOTCH1 and its oncogenic mutants in the additional pathways.

theme: Fibroblast activation and fibrotic wound repair
core_role: The shared pathways are fibroblast and myofibroblast differentiation and survival, ECM assembly, TGF-beta responsiveness and miRNA biogenesis that regulates them, framed as control of fibrotic connective tissue replacement in wound healing, with collagen and ECM regulation in the additional pathways.

theme: Synapse organization and excitatory-inhibitory balance
core_role: The shared pathways are inhibitory synapse assembly (gephyrin and GABA receptor clustering) and regulation of excitatory and inhibitory postsynaptic potentials, framed as synaptic organizer control of excitation-inhibition balance, within the general synapse assembly regulation of the additional pathways.

theme: Ovarian follicle development, ovulation and gonadotropin control
core_role: The shared pathways are follicle growth, ovulation, luteinization, oocyte maturation and gonadotropin secretion, framed as the hormonally driven female reproductive cycle, with FSH/LH responses, estrous cycle and luteolysis in the additional pathways.

theme: Renin-angiotensin and renal blood pressure regulation
core_role: The shared pathways are angiotensin signalling, renal sodium and urine excretion and natriuretic (guanylyl cyclase) counter-regulation, framed as renal-hormonal control of blood volume and systemic pressure, with vasopressin and vasomotor control in the additional pathways.
